hypotheses.reasoning: First anomaly at 12:11:42: payment-svc's calls to the card processor (api.cardproc.example) slowed to 5s, then 10s, then hit 30s timeouts (#147, #156). order-service's PaymentClient also waited the full 30s on each call (#148, #157). Those held calls filled order-service's 50-connection pool to payment-svc (#159, #169), which led to 503s at the gateway (#163 onward). Before 12:11 everything was healthy: Postgres, Redis and order-consumer look normal and there were no deploys.
The slow dependency is a third-party card processor. It may be having a provider-side outage, which our long 30s timeouts turned into pool saturation.

verdict.recommendedAction: Check the card processor's status page and contact the vendor. Cut payment-svc's processor timeout and order-service's PaymentClient timeout well below 30s, and add a circuit breaker or fail-fast so stuck calls can't fill the payment-svc connection pool. Consider queuing charges or degrading checkout gracefully until the processor recovers.
